items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: So we asked Joe Hubert to come and join our show and leave Boisse DeLegge and come with Happy Donovan and Travis Tucker. He said all right, he'd do it.

ctx.x: We left off...I think, you know, we'd been talking about a lot of things so we got away from the chronology, but we didn't talk about...I guess you went to Chicago, that was one place where you spent some time...

Yeah...well, I spent almost a year in Chicago. What had happened was, when I left the TOBA after the conclusion of that ill-fated tour, we went to Atlanta and...well, I've yet to tell you how I got my first wife, you know...we ll pick up there.

We left Memphis and went to Virginia. I'm not saying that that's the manner in which it was done or whether that's the time, but . We went to Danville, Virginia, and we had this show and a man by the name of Boisse DeLegge had , came into town at the same time we were there. So people used to just try to steal...not steal...but entice people from one show to the other. So the show that we were on needed three more people to go...well, four people...to go into Danville, Virginia. So we...there was a guy named…
